Jalapeno Lime Dip
By: Culinary Envy
Published: Thursday, March 23, 2017 - 12:43pm

Ingredients




4 whole large jalapenos, seeded with this handy tool
5 cloves garlic
½ cup fresh cilantro, rinse and pat dry
8 oz. light sour cream
½ cup mayonnaise
1 pkg. (1 oz.) dry ranch dip mix
½ a fresh lime, juiced
2-4 tablespoons milk
Tortilla chips, for serving

Preparation

1 Roughly chop the jalapenos, garlic and cilantro. Add to a food processor and pulse to chop, scraping down the sides a few times. 2 Add in the sour cream, mayonnaise, ranch dip mix and lime juice, then pulse until creamy. Then, start by adding 2 tablespoons of the milk slowly, until you've reached your desired consistency, adding in more if desired. Refrigerator for a half hour and then pour into a cute serving dish, and serve with tortilla chips or fresh veggies.

About

This Jalapeno Lime Dip is always the HIT of the Party!  Takes 5 minutes to make and uses fresh simple ingredients!
